title: Debug chat session reconnection issue
summary: **Summary:** User cannot reconnect to chat "Release app to Chrome Web Store" (id: `b33f33ec`). Reconnect button exists but does nothing. Root cause: the underlying privacy-doc prep task (`prep-privacy-md-for-publishing-at-emberstone-stu-dd8b`) was dispatched then trashed (`2026-08-06 12:43:24Z`) before completion, with no live agents currently running. That task was meant to adapt `PRIVACY.md` into `docs/privacy-meridian.md` for public publishing (strip internal Chrome Web Store disclosure section, adjust framing). A follow-up task, `owner-only-chrome-web-store-release-follow-ups-8398`, remains in backlog untouched. User clarified they're asking about the trashed task, not the chat itself. Next step: decide whether to restore and redispatch the stale trashed task or create a fresh one to produce the privacy doc.
